claims.atomic_claim: Nightfall has a latest GitHub release inspectable through the GitHub API.
claims.limitation: GitHub API availability does not prove release safety.

claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release has downloadable assets.
claims.limitation: Asset presence does not prove source-to-binary correspondence.

claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release has checksum-like assets.
claims.limitation: Checksum presence does not prove independent trust.

claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release has signature-like assets.
claims.limitation: Signature presence requires public-key identity verification.

claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release binaries match source.
claims.limitation: Requires asset download, tag verification, build recipe and reproducibility boundary.

claims.atomic_claim: The latest Nightfall release is security-proven.
claims.limitation: Security requires audit, adversarial review, tests and time under real conditions.
